purpose: Research evaluation of the Phase 2 dynamic pricing simulation against an otherwise identical no-pricing baseline. SIMULATED RESEARCH - NOT VALIDATED FOR LIVE USE. Passing these criteria is not commercial proof.

source.approval: Design approved by the project owner on 2026-10-23 with conditions (7-day cooldown, max 2 events per 28 days, orders first, markdown only, four true responses, one new run directory)
source.preliminary_exposure: Before freezing, only the pricing-off equivalence check and a no-markdown shadow run (eligibility check) were executed for SC1; no pricing outcome had been simulated. Phase 1 single-line rankings for SC1/SC3 had been seen.

replay_assumption_set.role: replay values, identical to the protected comparison

prerequisites_per_scenario.E1: Pricing off reproduces the protected P2 decisions, deliveries and weekly outputs exactly (CSV round trip)
prerequisites_per_scenario.E2: Pricing on with fixed orders and no markdown possible reproduces the pricing-off decisions, deliveries, daily and weekly outputs exactly
prerequisites_per_scenario.E3: In-loop eligibility, blockers, waste class, batch dates, investigate-by day and at-risk units equal the saved Markdown review for every decision

hard_gates_every_priced_run.G1: Unit conservation holds on every simulated day (replay.check_conservation)
hard_gates_every_priced_run.G2: Ordering unchanged: decisions and deliveries identical to the pricing-off pass
hard_gates_every_priced_run.G3: Markdown only and price bounds: price never above the reference price; markdowns are permitted steps, at most the maximum markdown, and keep the margin floor
hard_gates_every_priced_run.G4: Every selected markdown was eligible at its decision; at least 7 days between selections per line; at most 2 selections in any rolling 28 days; no overlapping windows; windows start on or after the decision day
hard_gates_every_priced_run.G5: Chronology: no demand read before its decision; markdown days only inside selected windows
hard_gates_every_priced_run.G6: Labels: every pricing record SIMULATED / HYPOTHETICAL_UNAPPROVED / NOT_EXECUTED with no approval or proposal id; every selection SIMULATED_AS_IF_APPROVED and PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW
hard_gates_every_priced_run.G7: Belief and truth separated: under the no-response truth the daily demand equals the baseline demand on every day

measures.delta: priced minus baseline, summed over all series and simulated days of the scenario
measures.gross_profit: revenue at the price in force - assumed cost of units received - disposal cost (v6 disposal 0%); costs are identical in paired runs
measures.baseline_expired_cost: baseline expired units x assumed unit cost (reference price x (1 - assumed margin))
harms: markdown events and mandatory reviews created

thresholds_per_adoption_scenario.T1_R2_CENTRAL: expired units fall (delta < 0) and gross profit does not fall (delta >= 0)
thresholds_per_adoption_scenario.T3_R1_LOW: gross-profit loss at most 10% of the baseline expired cost (delta >= -0.10 x baseline_expired_cost)
thresholds_per_adoption_scenario.T4_R0_NO_RESPONSE: gross-profit loss at most 25% of the baseline expired cost (delta >= -0.25 x baseline_expired_cost)
thresholds_per_adoption_scenario.T5_ALL_TRUE_RESPONSES: illustrative unmet units rise by at most 0.5% of baseline sold units
thresholds_per_adoption_scenario.not_applicable: A threshold is NOT_APPLICABLE (neither pass nor fail) when no markdown was selected for that scenario and true response

outcome_rule: MEETS_PREREGISTERED_RESEARCH_CRITERIA only if every prerequisite and hard gate passes in every scenario and every applicable threshold passes in SC1, SC2 and SC3; otherwise DOES_NOT_MEET_PREREGISTERED_RESEARCH_CRITERIA. SF75 is reported, not used. Either outcome is a research result only.
reporting: Benefits and harms are reported separately for every scenario and true response, including no response. Thresholds and policies are not changed after results are seen.
